title: Level 3 (Advanced) - C-3
notes:
West leads the ♠Q against 3NT. South has only 6 top tricks (2 spades, the ♦A, and 3 clubs). South can develop 2 more tricks in hearts once the ♥A is knocked out. At least 1 more trick can be developed in diamonds. Dummy's blocked clubs might even be reached if the ♦Q provides an entry.

South can in fact guarantee his contract with careful timing. West's opening spade lead is won (ducking makes no difference). South next unblocks the clubs and leads the ♦J (cashing the ♦A first is fine). If the defense wins the ♦K, the ♦Q will be an entry to the clubs in dummy. If the ♦J is allowed to hold, South can knock out the ♥A, making sure of 9 tricks.
